events.title: 스티브 코펠 is appointed manager of 맨체스터 시티 following the resignation of Alan Ball .
Manager 후프 슈테벤스 leaves 로다 JC . He is replaced by interim-coach Eddy Achterberg , and later by 마르틴 욜 .
데이비드 베컴 scores the only goal of the match as 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 리버풀 1–0 in the Premier League at Old Trafford.
셰필드 웬즈데이 sign Italian midfielder Benito Carbone from 인테르 for a club record £3 million.
사우샘프턴 sign Dutch defender Ulrich van Gobbel from 갈라타사라이 for £1.3 million.
과테말라시티 경기장 참사 — 과테말라와 코스타리카의 월드컵 예선을 앞두고 경기장 관중 압사 사고가 발생했다. 입장권과 관중 통제를 둘러싼 문제가 제기됐다.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 goalscoring legend Tony Cottee , who has lost his place in the first team this season, signs for Malaysian club Selangor for £750,000.
윔블던's recent run of fine form continues as they beat 첼시 4–2 in the league at Stamford Bridge .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 5–0 in a Premier League fixture, which ends the division's longest unbeaten start to the season.
첼시 director Matthew Harding , 42, is killed with four other people in a helicopter crash in Cheshire on his journey home from the club's League Cup defeat against 볼턴 원더러스 .
Ray Harford resigns as manager of 블랙번 로버스 , bottom of the FA Premier League just 18 months after being champions, and coach Tony Parkes takes over until the end of the season.
맨체스터 유나이티드 endure another heavy defeat, this time a 6–3 crushing at 사우샘프턴 in which Norwegian striker Egil Østenstad scores a hat-trick.
에버턴 pay a club record £5.75 million to 미들즈브러 for Nick Barmby .

맨체스터 유나이티드, unbeaten since they first played in Europe 40 years ago, finally suffer a home defeat in a European fixture when they lost 1–0 at home to Fenerbahçe in their fourth group match of the UEFA Champions League .

아스널 end their first month under 아르센 벵거's management as Premier League leaders on goal difference ahead of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, while 윔블던 are close behind in third, 리버풀 are fourth (with two games in hand over the top three) and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are now fifth after two successive hefty league defeats. 셰필드 웬즈데이's excellent start has ebbed away and they now occupy eighth place just two months after leading the league. 블랙번 로버스 are still bottom of the table and winless after 11 games, while they and 코번트리 시티 are now joined by 노팅엄 포리스트 in the relegation zone after 사우샘프턴 climbed to a secure 14th place with the 6–3 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 playing a big part in their recent improvement. In Division One, 볼턴 원더러스 remain top of Division One, with the other automatic promotion place now occupied by 노리치 시티. The playoff places are occupied by 크리스털 팰리스, 반즐리, 트랜미어 로버스 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
